hook.text: Active traders drown in information and still miss the move. So I built Thastock — an AI market desk that reads your watchlist before the bell and tells you the moment something changes.

brief.text: Eight-thirty, every trading day: an AI-written brief on your tickers. Overnight moves, RSI levels, earnings dates, macro — not generic market news.

alert.text: Then the alert engine watches price, RSI, volume and moving averages, and fires the second a condition is met.

research.text: Drop a ticker, get a thesis in seconds — momentum, risk score, analyst consensus, directional bias.

insider.text: And SEC Form 4 filings parsed in real time, so you see what the C-suite does with their own money.

cta.text: Eight thousand equities screened, portfolios stress-tested. Free forever, nine dollars a month for pro. Built end to end — Thastock dot com.
